'''Mass Manager''' is an [[Experimental Effects|Experimental Effect]] for [[Frame Shift Drive|Frame Shift Drives]]. It increases optimized mass by 4%, generally improving jump range, while reducing FSD integrity by 8%.<ref name="mass-manager">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Mass_Manager Mass Manager], Elite Dangerous Wiki.</ref>

{{#invoke:ExperimentalEffects|infobox|fsd_mass_manager}}

== Mechanical effects ==

{{#invoke:ExperimentalEffects|effectsTable|fsd_mass_manager}}

Optimized mass describes how efficiently the drive moves the ship's mass. Increasing it improves jump performance, but the resulting range change is not a fixed 4% because the FSD equation also accounts for drive class and rating, ship mass, fuel load, and maximum fuel per jump.

Mass Manager does not increase the amount of fuel the FSD may consume per jump. Its integrity penalty instead makes the module less resistant to damage and malfunction.

== Selection considerations ==

Mass Manager is a common range-focused choice, especially on larger Frame Shift Drives. It can be installed alongside any compatible Blueprint, including [[Increased Range]], [[Faster Boot Sequence]], or [[Shielded]], but it occupies the drive's single Experimental Effect slot.

[[Deep Charge]] is the other range-oriented FSD Experimental Effect. Deep Charge increases maximum fuel per jump, while Mass Manager improves optimized mass without increasing fuel consumption. The better maximum-range result varies with FSD class and the complete build; Mass Manager is generally the more fuel-efficient choice for repeated travel.

Choose a durability-focused effect such as [[Double Braced]] instead when FSD integrity matters more than additional range. [[Stripped Down]] reduces the module's own mass, while [[Thermal Spread]] reduces its thermal load.

== Compatible Blueprints ==

{{#invoke:ExperimentalEffects|compatibleBlueprints|fsd_mass_manager}}

Experimental Effects must be installed at an Engineer workshop. They cannot be applied through [[Remote Engineering]].
